_note: Places NISAR Watch (python -m pipeline, docs/AUTOMATION.md) checks for change on every run. Slugs get an 'auto-' prefix. Curated gallery places and study sites are not listed here: they are refreshed by the reviewed nisar-curated-refresh workflow. Fields: slug, name, region, kind, lon, lat, half_km (window half-width), optional theme, frame (pin a track/frame), start (first pass date), note.
